text: Assumption: Because the logging framework retains ownership of the logger instances according to SWS_LOG_00021, their lifetime is coupled to the runtime of the parent process — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Because the logging framework retains ownership of the logger instances according to SWS_LOG_00021, their lifetime is coupled to the runtime of the parent process — is this correct?
norm: because the logging framework retains ownership of the logger instances according to sws_log_00021 their lifetime is coupled to the runtime of the parent process
assumption: Because the logging framework retains ownership of the logger instances according to SWS_LOG_00021, their lifetime is coupled to the runtime of the parent process.
rationale: SWS_LOG_00021 specifies 'Ownership stays within the Logging framework', but does not define any destruction or deregistration APIs.

original.text: Annahme: Da das Logging-Framework gemäß SWS_LOG_00021 den Besitz der Logger-Instanzen behält, wird interpretiert, dass deren Lebensdauer an die Laufzeit des übergeordneten Prozesses gekoppelt ist — trifft das zu?
